purpose: Teach: 鉄鋼/請負/車体/減量/オペレーション/戸籍/養子/打開

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、鉄鋼業を研究テーマにしてみろ
lines.en: Ren, I want you to make steel-industry research your focus.
lines.style: Calm, measured directive. Slight weight on the name. Not unkind — this is trust disguised as assignment. Direct eye contact held.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。共同研究は請負契約で進めます
lines.en: Yes. We'll move forward with the collaborative research under contract terms.
lines.style: Respectful but steady. No hesitation. Each clause lands clearly. Quiet confidence that the plan is sound. The slight formality of someone proving they're listening and understanding.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、実験装置の車体構造も分析しろ
lines.en: And analyze the experimental equipment's structural design as well.
lines.style: Continues without pause, adding weight. Not rushed — each instruction sits. The tone of someone used to being followed. Measured, professional, expecting competence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験ロットの減量を検討しております
lines.en: Yes. We're already reviewing ways to reduce the experimental lot size.
lines.style: Slight uptick in pace — he's ahead of the thought. Respectful cadence but with the confidence of someone showing he's anticipated the direction. Not defensive, just prepared.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、実験オペレーションを誰でもできるようにしろ
lines.en: Make the experimental operations simple enough that anyone can run them.
lines.style: Sharper attack this time — conviction on 'anyone'. The tone shifts slightly toward emphasis. Still professional, but this matters. Clear, non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。協力者の戸籍関連書類をいただいております
lines.en: Yes. We've already collected the necessary documentation from our collaborators.
lines.style: Quick, efficient response. Minimal breath work — he's moving through the checklist of readiness. Professional flatness covering the underlying attentiveness. Shows he's already thinking three steps ahead.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、養子の医療研究にも興味を持て
lines.en: And develop an interest in the medical research side — including adoption-related angles.
lines.style: Slightly softer than the previous directives, but no less clear. A moment where the boss reveals something personal. The instruction carries unexpected depth. Thoughtful, not warm, but present.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究の壁を打開するアイデアを考えております
lines.en: Yes. I'm working on an idea to break through the research barriers we're facing.
lines.style: Quiet finish. Steady, sincere tone. This is a closing promise, not just compliance. The slight slowdown suggests he understands the weight of what's been asked. Respectful trailing breath.
